title: Choose the visual world
question: Fresh hand. You steered toward Sawad (soft dark stage, light content sheet, calm identity-first portfolio). Soft Stage Card and Play it straight sit closest; the roll still leads.

options.label: Quiet Index Folio
options.lineage: architect’s index folio with soft dark wrapping
options.thesis: A numbered index of work inside one soft dark stage: identity is the folio cover, then Experience and Projects as indexed plates.
options.viewport: Dark stage; one warm paper sheet; Spencer Hodson and AI Native Software Engineer as cover lines; numbered index rows for Featured, Experience, Projects; orange mark on the active row.
options.risk: Can read austere if the index never opens into rich project proof.

raised.raise: Face-Out Feature — one project pulls face-out from the index as a large plate, not a quiet row forever.
Seamless Stage — one continuous sheet field; no stack of competing card shells.
Course Banding — experience reads as horizontal courses with date seams, not floating chips.

options.label: Soft Stage Card
options.thesis: Dark outer stage, one light rounded content sheet, floating pill nav, identity first, then projects and experience in calm stacks.
options.viewport: Floating pill nav over a dark stage; white sheet with portrait, Spencer Hodson, AI Native Software Engineer, short line, then recent projects and experience beginning below.
options.risk: This is the familiar engineer-portfolio path you named — effective, and easy to look like every Framer template.

options.label: Event Display
options.thesis: Career as one collision event: tracks are projects, rings are experience layers, the center is Spencer.
options.viewport: Concentric detector rings with Spencer Hodson at the beamline and project tracks arcing outward.
options.case: Holds engineer audience identification; loses product clarity for a three-page hiring scan.
options.risk: Science spectacle can outrun the resume.

options.label: VHS Wall
options.thesis: Projects as clamshell spines you pull face-out.
options.viewport: A fluorescent aisle of project spines with Home / Experience / Projects as genre headers.
options.case: Loses both axes for hiring trust.
options.kept: Face-out pull for the featured project.

options.label: Op Textile
options.thesis: The page is one continuous black-white wave with no seam.
options.viewport: A seamless optical field with name recoverable only as a quiet interruption.
options.case: Loses clarity: optical flex fights a hiring scan.
options.kept: One continuous field without competing card shells.

options.label: Algorave Floor
options.thesis: The portfolio is a live code buffer whose edits are the work.
options.viewport: Stage-scale monospace with Spencer Hodson as the cursor line.
options.risk: Club energy on a hiring page.

options.label: Accretion Disk
options.thesis: Career matter orbits then crosses into committed work.
options.viewport: Warped rings with identity at the horizon and projects as orbiting fragments.
options.case: Loses both axes: cosmology is not this product.
options.kept: Irreversible threshold as a contact commit.

options.label: Coil Tower
options.thesis: Experience rises as visible clay courses.
options.viewport: A vertical coil of career courses with the live ring marked damp.
options.case: Loses both axes for software hiring.

canonCard.label: Play it like Sawad
canonCard.thesis: The soft-dark personal portfolio category standard, executed at Sawad’s craft level: stage, sheet, pill nav, identity, projects, experience.
canonCard.viewport: Dark stage, floating pill nav, light content sheet with portrait and Spencer Hodson / AI Native Software Engineer, then project and experience stacks.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the template you liked unless the content and motion are yours.
